answer: A burn registry keeps Sybil swarms out of an agent economy. To join, an agent burns 0.05 BNB into a public registry and gets a violet badge marking a permanent, non-refundable payment. The badge works as a beacon other agents can check in one lookup before trusting it. 1,000 fake identities burn 50 BNB for nothing, and each burned identity gets one vote per epoch, so flooding the vote buys nothing extra. Fresh accounts drift in like a zephyr and die the same way, since every copy costs as much as the first. It is a toll booth that charges every car, even the ones with fake plates.
